subject: Field Day post-event revenue mapping and disputed credits
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Field Day post-event revenue mapping and initial numbers

Team —

Thanks for the quick debrief yesterday. I uploaded the initial mapping export to Drive (link below) and attached the event line items CSV. Quick summary of what I pulled together for BluePeak:

- Gross influenced pipeline (marketing-influenced as per MQL->SQL tagging): $412,000
- Credited pipeline in HubSpot closed/won so far: $210,000
- Expected Brownfield adjustments (partner-assisted deals): ~ $35,000

There are two obvious discrepancies that need resolution before we finalize the Field Day ROI report for the exec deck:
1) Multiple deals show both SDR and Event credit in HubSpot which inflates influenced totals if we roll up by touch. Need to decide whether we split credit or use highest-touch logic.
2) A closed-won on 6/18 (Acme variant) has SFDC mapping to BluePeak that doesn't show in HS export — looks like a manual company merge.

Action items I recommend:
- Ben: reconcile the HubSpot export against the attached DealLineItems.csv and flag mismatches (see column "hs_deal_id").
- Marissa: confirm partner credit rules — do we auto-apply 25% partner credit for BluePeak-sourced leads?
- Vivek: decide if policy allows giving a one-time co-marketing credit for the $35k partner-influenced pipeline if BluePeak escalates.

I’ll draft the ROI slide after we lock the final #s — we should have a clean number by EOD Monday if everyone is aligned.

Attachments: FieldDay-DealLineItems.csv (CSV, 14 rows)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3c_FieldDay_Mapping

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field Day post-event revenue mapping and initial numbers

Hannah —

I pulled HubSpot export (attached) and crosswalked against the DealLineItems. High-level findings:
- 3 deals (HS IDs 3421, 3478, 3510) show dual-touch: SDR + Event. If we sum touch values we double-count $48,500.
- One deal (HS ID 3499) closed 6/18 but was merged into a parent company record with a different company name; HubSpot export excludes it. SFDC shows the $98k closed-won and links to BP opportunity 5542.
- Partner tag for BluePeak is inconsistent — some rows have "partner:bluepeak", others have free-text.

Recommendation: use highest-touch attribution for the ROI deck (event > SDR > campaign) and create a reconciliation column for "merged deals" that maps parent SFDC opp IDs. That removes the double-counting and still reflects partner influence.

I attached: HubSpot-export-0626.csv (27 rows), and a reconciliation CSV with proposed hs_deal_id -> sfdc_opp mappings.

Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field Day post-event revenue mapping and initial numbers

Team —

Thanks Ben, that approach sounds fine for the deck. A few policy notes — per our partner crediting framework:
- BluePeak is a Tier B partner (eligible for up to 20% partner credit on sourced opportunities). It’s discretionary for event-assisted leads; we typically cap at $25k total for co-marketing adjustments per quarter.
- For partner-influenced multi-touch rows, we apply partner credit only if the partner is listed at lead creation. Manual tags after the fact do not qualify without partner-signed acknowledgement.

If BluePeak wants a credit for the $35k line items that were partner-assisted, we'll need:
1) an email from their PM confirming involvement, or
2) evidence in the portal (referral link or invite code) showing BluePeak as source.

I can loop in partner success if you want me to request the email from Julia.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Partnerships & Channel, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick decision so we can close the ROI numbers for the exec slide:
- Apply highest-touch attribution to avoid double-counting (Ben’s reconciliation).
- Given Julia's PM confirmation, approve partner credit for the two confirmed HS IDs (3421 and 3510). Apply a 15% partner credit to those deals (within our Tier B guidelines and under the $25k cap).
- As a one-time gesture, waive the documentation requirement for the $35k bucket only for BluePeak (since PM note is in-thread). This is exception-only and must be logged in MKT-1124.

Hannah — please update the FieldDay-revenue-mapping-0628.xlsx with final numbers and forward the ROI slide draft to me by EOD. I'll sign off.

Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
